_doc: GENERATED by scripts/native/gen.mjs. export = what native/shared/gen/migration-export.js returns inside the old Capacitor WebView origin (capacitor://localhost on iOS, https://localhost on Android); expect = what the native store must hold afterwards, computed by loading that export into the real web/js/core.js Store (IndexedDB "lexkite" kv + localStorage "ielts.*", legacy "vocaband" DB, normalize: invalid cards dropped, keys re-normalised, defaults added with clock = now) and reading it back as a Doc (+ pulledHashes).

cases.name: unicode words, target-language cards, key re-normalised
corrupted entries skipped (null card, card without word, broken JSON value)
pre-IndexedDB install: cards still in localStorage, newer mod wins over IndexedDB copy
very old install: legacy "vocaband" IndexedDB only
sandbox (?sandbox=1) and dictionary-cache keys are not learner data

beta.def: a number showing how much a share price moves compared with the market
beta.ex: Shares with a high beta usually rise and fall more sharply than the market.

curriculum.def: the set of subjects and topics that a school, college or course teaches
curriculum.ex: Many people argue that practical life skills should be added to the school curriculum.

good.ex: This is a good place to study.

legacy.def: something left from the past, or money left after someone dies
legacy.ex: The factory is a legacy of the town's industrial past.

partial.ex: We received a partial payment from the client.

real.def: actually existing or happening, not imagined
